title: The future subjunctive
objectives: I can form the future subjunctive of regular and irregular verbs from the third person plural of the preterite.
I can use quando, assim que, logo que, depois que, enquanto and sempre que with the future subjunctive to talk about future events.
I can state real conditions with se + future subjunctive, as in Se você quiser, eu ajudo.
I can tell apart a habit or past event (indicative) from a future event (future subjunctive) in the same sentence pattern.

example.pt: Assim que eu chegar, te ligo.
example.en: As soon as I arrive, I'll call you.

example.pt: Logo que o pacote chegar, eu aviso você.
example.en: As soon as the package arrives, I'll let you know.

example.pt: Depois que você terminar, podemos sair.
example.en: After you finish, we can go out.

example.pt: Sempre que eu puder, vou visitar meus avós.
example.en: Whenever I can, I'll visit my grandparents.

example.pt: Enquanto você estiver aqui, pode usar meu carro.
example.en: As long as you are here, you can use my car.

vocabulary.note: Very common in everyday Brazilian speech when talking about plans.

example.pt: Vamos viajar em julho, se Deus quiser.
example.en: We'll travel in July, God willing.

example.pt: Prometo que te ligo assim que eu puder.
example.en: I promise I'll call you as soon as I can.

example.pt: Se eu fizer uma promessa, eu cumpro.
example.en: If I make a promise, I keep it.

example.pt: Vamos combinar um horário quando você souber a agenda.
example.en: Let's agree on a time when you know your schedule.

example.pt: Se vocês chegarem a um acordo, me avisem.
example.en: If you reach an agreement, let me know.

example.pt: Se o prazo acabar na sexta, a gente termina hoje.
example.en: If the deadline ends on Friday, we'll finish today.

example.pt: A entrega será rápida se você pagar hoje.
example.en: The delivery will be quick if you pay today.

example.pt: Quando a encomenda chegar, confira os itens.
example.en: When the order arrives, check the items.

vocabulary.note: In business, pedir um orçamento means to ask for a price quote.

example.pt: Se o orçamento for aprovado, começamos na segunda.
example.en: If the quote is approved, we start on Monday.

example.pt: Se eles aceitarem o preço, fechamos negócio.
example.en: If they accept the price, we close the deal.

example.pt: Quando o fornecedor responder, eu te conto.
example.en: When the supplier answers, I'll tell you.

example.pt: Faço a reserva assim que você confirmar.
example.en: I'll make the reservation as soon as you confirm.

example.pt: Me avise quando você confirmar a presença.
example.en: Let me know when you confirm your attendance.

example.pt: Se chover, vamos remarcar o passeio.
example.en: If it rains, we'll reschedule the outing.

example.pt: Se a previsão do tempo estiver certa, vai chover amanhã.
example.en: If the weather forecast is right, it will rain tomorrow.

example.pt: Se houver tempestade, o voo vai atrasar.
example.en: If there is a storm, the flight will be delayed.

example.pt: Quando o voo sair, eu te mando uma mensagem.
example.en: When the flight leaves, I'll send you a message.

vocabulary.note: Singular in Portuguese and used for the whole luggage: a bagagem, as bagagens.

example.pt: Assim que a bagagem chegar, a gente vai para o hotel.
example.en: As soon as the luggage arrives, we'll go to the hotel.

example.pt: Se tivermos tempo, vamos mudar o roteiro.
example.en: If we have time, we'll change the itinerary.

example.pt: Se houver atraso, eu aviso você.
example.en: If there is a delay, I'll let you know.

example.pt: Me avise quando você chegar.
example.en: Let me know when you arrive.

dialogues.title: Fechando negócio
dialogues.context: Marcos buys office equipment for his company. Patrícia, a supplier, calls to agree on delivery and payment.

lines.speaker: Patrícia
lines.pt: Bom dia, Marcos. Quando vocês quiserem receber a encomenda, é só avisar.
lines.en: Good morning, Marcos. Whenever you want to receive the order, just let us know.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Bom dia, Patrícia. Se o orçamento for aprovado, queremos a entrega até o dia vinte.
lines.en: Good morning, Patrícia. If the quote is approved, we want delivery by the twentieth.

lines.speaker: Patrícia
lines.pt: Fechado. Assim que eu tiver a confirmação da fábrica, te ligo.
lines.en: Deal. As soon as I have the confirmation from the factory, I'll call you.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Perfeito. Se houver algum atraso, me avise logo que você souber.
lines.en: Perfect. If there is any delay, let me know as soon as you find out.

lines.speaker: Patrícia
lines.pt: Pode deixar. Prometo que aviso assim que eu souber de qualquer coisa.
lines.en: Will do. I promise I'll tell you as soon as I know anything.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: E o pagamento? Pago metade agora e metade depois que a encomenda chegar.
lines.en: And the payment? I'll pay half now and half after the order arrives.

lines.speaker: Patrícia
lines.pt: Pode ser. Sempre que um cliente paga assim, eu faço um desconto.
lines.en: That works. Whenever a client pays like that, I give a discount.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Ótimo! Então, se tudo der certo, fechamos negócio hoje.
lines.en: Great! Then, if all goes well, we close the deal today.

lines.speaker: Patrícia
lines.pt: Combinado. Vou mandar o contrato por e-mail quando terminarmos a ligação.
lines.en: Agreed. I'll send the contract by e-mail when we finish the call.

dialogues.title: Planejando a viagem a Gramado
dialogues.context: Isabela and Fernando plan a winter trip to Gramado and worry about the weather and the flight.

lines.speaker: Isabela
lines.pt: Fernando, vamos confirmar o roteiro? Quando a gente chegar em Porto Alegre, pegamos um carro e vamos pra Gramado.
lines.en: Fernando, shall we confirm the itinerary? When we arrive in Porto Alegre, we get a car and go to Gramado.

lines.speaker: Fernando
lines.pt: Isso. Assim que a gente deixar a bagagem no hotel, saímos pra almoçar.
lines.en: Right. As soon as we drop the luggage at the hotel, we go out for lunch.

lines.speaker: Isabela
lines.pt: Vi a previsão do tempo. Se chover muito no sábado, a gente remarca o passeio.
lines.en: I saw the weather forecast. If it rains a lot on Saturday, we reschedule the outing.

lines.speaker: Fernando
lines.pt: Boa. Se houver tempestade, o voo também pode atrasar.
lines.en: Good. If there is a storm, the flight may also be delayed.

lines.speaker: Isabela
lines.pt: Verdade. Vou ligar pra companhia assim que eu tiver o número da reserva.
lines.en: True. I'll call the airline as soon as I have the reservation number.

lines.speaker: Fernando
lines.pt: Pode deixar que eu faço isso. Sempre que eu viajo, confirmo tudo com antecedência.
lines.en: Leave that to me. Whenever I travel, I confirm everything in advance.

lines.speaker: Isabela
lines.pt: Ótimo. E, se Deus quiser, vamos aproveitar o frio da serra.
lines.en: Great. And, God willing, we'll enjoy the cold of the mountains.

lines.speaker: Fernando
lines.pt: Se Deus quiser! Enquanto estivermos lá, só quero comer fondue.
lines.en: God willing! While we're there, I only want to eat fondue.

dialogues.title: Antes da viagem de trabalho
dialogues.context: Gustavo is about to leave on a business trip. His friend Rafaela wants to be sure they still meet when he gets back.

lines.speaker: Gustavo
lines.pt: Rafa, vou viajar amanhã a trabalho. Quando eu voltar, a gente combina aquele jantar?
lines.en: Rafa, I'm traveling tomorrow for work. When I'm back, shall we arrange that dinner?

lines.speaker: Rafaela
lines.pt: Combinado! Me liga assim que você chegar lá.
lines.en: Deal! Call me as soon as you get there.

lines.speaker: Gustavo
lines.pt: Prometo que ligo logo que eu puder. Se o voo atrasar, mando uma mensagem.
lines.en: I promise I'll call as soon as I can. If the flight is delayed, I'll send a message.

lines.speaker: Rafaela
lines.pt: Tá bom. Sempre que você viaja, esquece de avisar.
lines.en: Okay. Whenever you travel, you forget to let people know.

lines.speaker: Gustavo
lines.pt: Desta vez eu aviso, juro. E se você precisar de alguma coisa, é só falar.
lines.en: This time I'll let you know, I swear. And if you need anything, just say so.

lines.speaker: Rafaela
lines.pt: Se eu precisar, falo. Depois que você voltar, quero ouvir todas as histórias.
lines.en: If I need anything, I'll say so. After you come back, I want to hear all the stories.

lines.speaker: Gustavo
lines.pt: Pode deixar. Onde eu for, vou tirar fotos pra você.
lines.en: Will do. Wherever I go, I'll take photos for you.

lines.speaker: Rafaela
lines.pt: Boa viagem! Que dê tudo certo.
lines.en: Have a good trip! May everything go well.

grammar.title: Forming the future subjunctive
grammar.explanation:
The future subjunctive is used for events that have not happened yet but are expected or possible: Quando eu chegar (when I arrive), Se você quiser (if you want). English uses the plain present in these clauses, so learners tend to say Quando eu chego, which in Portuguese would sound like a habit, not a future event.

To form it, take the eles form of the preterite (falaram, comeram, partiram), remove -am (falar-, comer-, partir-) and add the endings: nothing for eu, você, ele and ela; -mos for nós; -em for vocês and eles. The resulting forms are falar, falar, falarmos, falarem. For regular verbs they are identical to the infinitive and the personal infinitive, so context tells you which one it is. In the regions that use tu, add -es: falares.

Irregular verbs use the irregular preterite stem (fizeram, fizer; tiveram, tiver) and are listed in the next note. The tense is rare in English but easy to recognize in Portuguese: it almost always follows quando, se, assim que, enquanto or a similar word and refers to the future.

examples.pt: Quando eu falar com ela, aviso você.
examples.en: When I talk to her, I'll let you know.

examples.pt: Se você comer tudo, ganha sobremesa.
examples.en: If you eat everything, you get dessert.

examples.pt: Assim que o filme terminar, vamos jantar.
examples.en: As soon as the movie ends, we'll have dinner.

examples.pt: Quando vocês chegarem, a gente começa.
examples.en: When you arrive, we'll start.

examples.pt: Depois que nós partirmos, ninguém vai saber.
examples.en: After we leave, nobody will know.

grammar.title: Irregular future subjunctive forms
grammar.explanation:
Irregular verbs follow exactly the same recipe: take the eles form of the preterite, remove -am and add the endings. Because the preterite of these verbs has an irregular stem, so does the future subjunctive: tiveram, tiver; fizeram, fizer; puderam, puder; quiseram, quiser; vieram, vier; disseram, disser; puseram, puser.

The verb ser and the verb ir share one preterite (foram), so they share one future subjunctive: for. Se eu for a São Paulo could mean 'if I go' or 'if I am there', and context decides. Watch out for a classic trap: ver gives vir (viram) while vir gives vier (vieram). Se eu vir você means 'if I see you' and Se eu vier means 'if I come'.

Haver is used impersonally and appears in the singular houver: Se houver problema, me avise. Compounds follow their base verb: manter, mantiver; desfazer, desfizer; convir, convier; prever, previr. Dar also gives a very useful fixed form: Quando der, me ligue (whenever possible, call me).

examples.pt: Se eu tiver tempo, vou ao cinema.
examples.en: If I have time, I'll go to the cinema.

examples.pt: Quando ela estiver pronta, saímos.
examples.en: When she is ready, we'll leave.

examples.pt: Se você fizer o trabalho, eu ajudo.
examples.en: If you do the work, I'll help.

examples.pt: Se eles vierem, avisam a gente.
examples.en: If they come, they'll tell us.

examples.pt: Se você vir o João, dê um abraço nele.
examples.en: If you see João, give him a hug.

examples.pt: Quando você puder, me liga.
examples.en: When you can, call me.

grammar.title: Time words and se: future versus habit versus past
grammar.explanation:
The future subjunctive appears after time conjunctions when the action lies in the future: quando (when), assim que and logo que (as soon as), depois que (after), enquanto (while, as long as), sempre que (whenever). The main clause is usually in the present, in the ir + infinitive future, or in the imperative: Quando eu chegar, te ligo.

The same conjunctions take the indicative when the time is past or habitual. The mood tells you the time frame. Quando cheguei is past; Quando chego is a routine; Quando chegar is a future event. Using the wrong mood changes the meaning, so never translate the English present literally.

The same logic governs real conditions with se: Se você quiser, eu ajudo (If you want, I'll help). Use the future subjunctive after se when the condition is still open and possible. If the condition is a general truth or a habit, use the indicative: Se chove, não saio (If it rains, I don't go out). Unreal, hypothetical conditions use another tense, covered in the next unit.

examples.pt: Assim que eu chegar, te ligo.
examples.en: As soon as I arrive, I'll call you.

examples.pt: Enquanto você estiver aqui, a gente passeia.
examples.en: As long as you are here, we'll go sightseeing.

examples.pt: Sempre que eu puder, viajo para o litoral.
examples.en: Whenever I can, I go to the coast.

examples.pt: Se você quiser, eu ajudo.
examples.en: If you want, I'll help.

examples.pt: Depois que vocês assinarem, pagamos a entrada.
examples.en: After you sign, we'll pay the deposit.

examples.pt: Sempre que chove, o trânsito para.
examples.en: Whenever it rains, traffic stops.

grammar.title: Quem, o que, onde, como and fixed phrases
grammar.explanation:
The future subjunctive also follows question words used as relatives when the person, thing or place is not yet identified: Quem chegar primeiro escolhe (whoever arrives first chooses), Faça o que você quiser (do whatever you want), Onde você for, eu vou (wherever you go, I go), Como você preferir (however you prefer). The idea is the same: the event has not happened and the identity is open.

The tense also sits inside several fixed expressions that Brazilians use every day. Learn them as chunks: Se Deus quiser (God willing), Seja como for (be that as it may), Custe o que custar (at any cost), Haja o que houver (come what may), Quando der (whenever possible) and the colloquial Se bobear (if we are not careful, maybe).

Quanto mais... mais... compares two developing changes: Quanto mais você estudar, mais vai aprender (the more you study, the more you will learn). In casual speech, Qualquer coisa, me avisa literally means 'anything, let me know' and is a very common way of saying 'if anything comes up'.

examples.pt: Quem chegar primeiro escolhe a mesa.
examples.en: Whoever arrives first chooses the table.

examples.pt: Faça o que você quiser.
examples.en: Do whatever you want.

examples.pt: Onde você for, eu vou também.
examples.en: Wherever you go, I'll go too.

examples.pt: Quanto mais você estudar, mais vai aprender.
examples.en: The more you study, the more you will learn.

examples.pt: Passo na sua casa quando der.
examples.en: I'll stop by your place when I can.

culture.title: Se Deus quiser, assim que der
culture.text:
Brazilians talk about the future with a mix of optimism and caution, and the future subjunctive is at the heart of it. Se Deus quiser is said about almost any plan, whether or not the speaker is religious; it expresses hope and a certain humility about the unknown. Quando der is another everyday phrase: it means 'when it is possible' and is used both as a sincere intention and as a polite way of not committing to a date.

Making plans often takes a casual form: a gente combina, vamos marcar, qualquer coisa, me avisa. A promise like Assim que eu puder, passo aí is friendly but flexible; a firm commitment would be stated with a date and time. Punctuality varies with the situation, and Brazilians usually expect a message if you are running late.

When traveling, weather and holidays shape plans. Summer brings heavy afternoon rain (chuva de verão), and the feriadão, a long weekend created by a holiday, fills roads and airports. Travel agents and airlines often say Caso haja alteração, avisaremos (If there is any change, we will notify you), which is a formal version of the same idea.

paragraphs.pt: No ano que vem, vou realizar um sonho antigo: conhecer Fernando de Noronha. Já comecei a planejar tudo, mas sei que os planos só vão funcionar se o tempo ajudar.
paragraphs.en: Next year, I'm going to fulfill an old dream: visiting Fernando de Noronha. I've already started planning everything, but I know the plans will only work if the weather cooperates.

paragraphs.pt: Vou comprar as passagens assim que a companhia abrir as vendas. Depois que eu confirmar a reserva da pousada, pago a taxa de preservação, que é obrigatória para todos os visitantes.
paragraphs.en: I'll buy the tickets as soon as the airline opens sales. After I confirm the inn reservation, I'll pay the preservation fee, which is mandatory for all visitors.

paragraphs.pt: A previsão do tempo é importante. Se chover muito, os passeios de barco podem ser cancelados, e nesse caso a agência promete remarcar sem custo.
paragraphs.en: The weather forecast is important. If it rains a lot, the boat trips can be canceled, and in that case the agency promises to reschedule at no cost.

paragraphs.pt: Enquanto eu estiver lá, quero mergulhar todos os dias. Minha irmã vai comigo, contanto que o chefe dela aprove as férias. Quando ela souber a resposta, vamos fechar o roteiro.
paragraphs.en: While I'm there, I want to dive every day. My sister is coming with me, provided her boss approves her vacation. When she knows the answer, we'll finalize the itinerary.

paragraphs.pt: Sempre que converso com alguém que já foi, ouço a mesma coisa: quem for uma vez vai querer voltar. Vou contar tudo aqui no blog logo que eu voltar.
paragraphs.en: Whenever I talk to someone who has been, I hear the same thing: whoever goes once will want to go back. I'll tell everything here on the blog as soon as I return.

As soon as the sister's boss decides

choices: If her boss approves her vacation

exercises.prompt: Match each expression with its meaning
Amanhã, assim que eu ___ em casa, te ligo.
exercises.explanation: A future event after assim que takes the future subjunctive: chegar.

exercises.prompt: What is the future subjunctive of fazer (eu)?

exercises.prompt_pt: Quando eu ___ tempo, vou visitar você.
exercises.hint_en: When I have time, I'll visit you. Verb: ter.

exercises.prompt: What does 'Se você quiser, eu ajudo' mean?
choices: If you wanted, I would have helped.
Because you want it, I help.
exercises.explanation: Se + future subjunctive states an open condition.

exercises.prompt_pt: Se vocês ___ ao Rio, me avisem.
exercises.hint_en: If you go to Rio, let me know. Verb: ir.
exercises.explanation: Ir and ser share for, forem.

exercises.audio_pt: Assim que eu chegar, te ligo.
choices: As soon as I arrived, I called you.
Whenever I arrive, I call you.
As soon as I arrive, I'll call you.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence describes a habit, not a future event?
choices: Sempre que chover, vou ficar em casa.
Sempre que chove, o trânsito para.
exercises.explanation: Chove in the indicative is a habit.

exercises.prompt_pt: Assim que nós ___ o pedido, mandamos a entrega.
exercises.hint_en: As soon as we receive the order, we send the delivery. Verb: receber.
exercises.explanation: Nós adds -mos to the infinitive: recebermos.

exercises.prompt: What is the future subjunctive of ver (eu)?
exercises.explanation: Ver gives vir (viram). Vier belongs to vir, to come.

exercises.prompt_en: After you finish, we can go out.

exercises.hint_en: If you can help, it will be great. Verb: poder.

exercises.audio_pt: Logo que o pacote chegar, eu aviso você.

exercises.hint_en: Do whatever you want. Verb: querer.

exercises.explanation: Metade depois que a encomenda chegar.

exercises.hint_en: When she is here, call me. Verb: estar.

exercises.prompt_en: If it rains, we will stay home.

exercises.prompt_pt: Se você ___ de ajuda, é só falar.
